verdict.rationale: NVIDIA documents a second-generation FP8 Transformer Engine on this part that accelerates LLM inference across PyTorch and TensorFlow, and pitches its 96 GB for running LLMs locally. A community build reports real inference throughput (41k tok/s) on four of these cards. However, no FP4 support is documented and no serving stack is named for this part. One critic also notes that SM120 lacks tcgen05/tmem and that main libraries target SM100, which limits the inference-stack story. Missing for 10: documented FP4/NVFP4 support for this part, named supported serving stacks (TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, llama.cpp) with per-part compatibility docs, and independent confirmation of library support on SM120.
